name: Mostar City Tour with Bosnian Coffee Tasting
tagline: The main landmarks of Mostar with a local guide, followed by a Bosnian coffee tasting where you learn how coffee is made, served and enjoyed.
imageAlt: The Crooked Bridge over the Radobolja in Mostar
level: Easy: uneven cobblestones and some steps
description: See the main landmarks of Mostar with a local guide, then take time to learn about Bosnian coffee and the customs around serving and drinking it. The coffee stop is part of the experience, not just a refreshment break: you hear about the džezva, the fildžan, the serving ritual and the place coffee holds in everyday life.

itinerary.text: Walk through the Old Town and the historic area around the Crooked Bridge.
Learn about Mostar’s bridges, the Old Bridge, its towers and the diving tradition.
Continue through Kujundžiluk and the bazaar streets.
Stop for a Bosnian coffee tasting and an explanation of the tradition.

practical: Tell us if anyone in your group does not drink coffee: we can suggest an alternative.
